outcomeInformedFrom.status: Both earlier epochs remain failed and byte-exact. New scripts are not retroactive successes.

unchangedScenario: Epoch2 initial serialized state, including 1100 gold and 2700/6000 HP, formation, normal paid AI, engine/economy and known seeds. Only policy metadata/cadence changes.
caseOrder: seed, then health control, then policy, in the arrays' order
policyContract: One attempted ordinary player command at most every 2 seconds from tick0. This is a disclosed scripted pace, not a human difficulty claim or UI restriction.
First add southern archeryx690, southern barracksx830, northern archeryx690 and northern sanctumx550, in that order. Inherited producers and successfully introduced additions are rebuilt when lost.

Urgent ordinary Volley may take priority when affordable/off cooldown and at least 3 living visible enemies cluster within one spell radius around an enemy inside 600 pixels of the home citadel. Aim at the largest cluster, then nearest core, then lowest unit ID.

Rebuild introduced production before development. Order missing producers by the nearest visible enemy's x within that lane/own half, then barracks/archery/sanctum/foundry, north/south/middle and frontmost. Take the first affordable repair; if none is affordable, retain the failed attempt and wait.

After four initial support additions, support-regen/arrows pay the ordinary 190 gold choice. Support-none skips it and may spend that decision on further support. All variants otherwise use identical logic; this is a real opportunity-cost comparison, not a healing-only placebo.

After current production is intact, repair introduced mines. Follow up with middle sanctumx550, southern archeryx550, north minex270, rear middle foundryx270, south minex270, rear north foundryx410 and rear south foundryx410. Rebuild each introduced asset if lost.

After that development, upgrade affordable surviving producers by lowest level, then the same visible lane/type priority and ID. No artificial ban on the player's actual UI actions; these scripts simply choose this bounded subset. No sale, new subsystem or resource buff is introduced.

Use only own state and currently player-visible units in this clear-view encounter. Do not read enemy gold, RNG/seed, future actions, prior results or hidden state. These are fresh outcome-informed scripts on reused known seeds, not heldout cases.
claimsToTest: Whether support-first placement and ordinary rebuilding sustain the visibly pressured south/north perimeter and permit a viable route under the unchanged setup.

Whether the same support logic with no citadel purchase, regeneration or same-price arrows produces a concrete pressure/spending/survival tradeoff. No-regeneration wins are welcome; regeneration need not be mandatory.
Whether the wound changes actual risk or pacing in otherwise identical initial states. Fixed scripts cannot establish human preference, human difficulty or overall encounter balance.

building losses by exact ID/type/position/original status and time

interpretation: Inspect all 16 cases including losses. No seed search, automatic retry, favorable-only report, extra policies or hidden holdouts.
Compare exact rebuilding and support timings and losses by building ID/position. More survival or some enemy damage alone does not establish a viable opener.

Compare wounded/full controls as total effects: ordinary AI/RNG paths can diverge after different legal actions and damage. Compare choices as real spending/defensive alternatives, not an isolated regeneration estimate.

Nominal healing or a larger HP display is insufficient to establish recovery value. Explain concrete risk, timing, losses or feasibility and preserve limitations. Do not impose arbitrary healing/win-rate thresholds or a mandatory-regeneration/forced-no-regen-loss gate.

Retain both prior errata: the sanctum at 10 seconds followed initial contact; in epoch 2 seed 9101 counterattack the first southern archery died at 105.60 seconds, while 96.25 seconds was a later archery. Earlier sealed reports stay unchanged.
A new successful script would show only bounded paid feasibility, not validate the earlier failed policies, human difficulty, browser pacing or production admission.
stop: Stop on source drift, ledger/price error, invalid restore or coordinator request. Retain errors and partial data outside source; no retry without new authorization.
